BL-1796 — A respawn forces the respawning daemon's own SWARMFORGE_USE provider flag onto every seat it respawns, whatever base the seat's own launch script names: a daemon started by start-swarm-glm.sh (SWARMFORGE_USE_BAI=1) or start-swarm-qwen.sh (SWARMFORGE_USE_QWEN=1) moves a local Ollama seat to that cloud provider and a seat on another cloud host to the flagged one (BL-1793 probe 3a); a seat whose launch script names an OpenAI base keeps it, and the flag path stays only for seats that name none
